notes.title: Big Update Soon
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 
Jens here.

I am nearly finished with the Mines Update.
It wont be DLC, just a big Patch that will extend the game with a new big Dungeon, some new Enemies and small stuff.

It should be online the next couple of days.

Happy Crawling!
